newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ACCC clears Santos gas acquisition.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ACCC clears Santos gas acquisition.

text.p: Anti-monopolies authority, the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC), said on Monday it would not intervene in gas producer Santos Ltd's A$200 million purchase of local oil and gas interests from Parker and Parsley Petroleum Co.
Santos announced in late March the purchase of the assets, which had been bought by Parker and Parsley when it took over Australia's Bridge Oil Ltd in 1994.
The ACCC said that the acquisition raised the level of concentration in natural gas production and marketing in the South Australian Cooper Basin and the Surat Basin in central and eastern Australia.

"The ACCC was concerned the acquisition may be likely to result in substantial lessening of competition after the acquisition by Santos of a further independent gas producer in the South Australian Cooper Basin," it said.
"It remains concerned that the further concentration at the gas production and marketing levels may hinder the potential benefits from a competitive gas market."
The ACCC said it had conducted an extensive inquiry into the acquisition and a number of industry participants had raised concerns about the acquisition.
"But, to date, the ACCC has not been able to obtain sufficient evidence on which to take the matter further," the ACCC said.
"While the ACCC still retains concerns regarding competition in gas markets in central and eastern Australia, it has decided not to pursue the acquisition."
